svg.title: Among enterprises of the same size, the share using AI varies widely by country
svg.desc: Bar chart: Among enterprises of the same size, the share using AI varies widely by country: Enterprises with 10–49 employees: Denmark: 37.5%, Finland: 33.5%, Netherlands: 28.8%, Germany: 23.1%, France: 15.0%, Italy: 14.2%, Türkiye: 6.6%, Poland: 5.8%, Romania: 4.1%, EU overall: 17.0%, Türkiye, 250+ employees: 23.5%.
